upsert.title: IL-15 immunotherapy for canine melanoma or osteosarcoma with pulmonary metastasis
upsert.center: Evergreen Animal Hospital (長青動物醫院), Taipei
upsert.contacts: Evergreen Animal Hospital main hospital oncology clinic, Taipei; phone 02-23369908. Ask for IL15臨床試驗.
upsert.notes: Official hospital recruitment page. Cytology- or histopathology-confirmed melanoma or osteosarcoma; breed, age, weight and sex unrestricted. Requires pulmonary metastatic lesion >1.0 cm and no life-threatening tumor-related symptoms. Current steroids or other immunosuppressants are not allowed. Owner must attend weekly treatment/follow-up for about 10-12 weeks. IL-15 is given weekly for 8 treatments, by subcutaneous injection and, for pulmonary metastatic disease, also via nebulized inhalation. IL-15 drug is free; diagnostics and supportive medications are owner-paid. IMPORTANT matcher prescreen: official protocol specifically requires a lung metastatic lesion >1.0 cm; current schema cannot encode the 1-cm pulmonary-lesion threshold separately, so final eligibility must confirm this criterion.

upsert.title: PT001 PD-L1/CTLA-4 recombinant protein therapeutic vaccine for stage II-III canine oral malignant melanoma
upsert.center: Protect Animal Health (寶泰生醫) multicenter field trial
upsert.contacts: Participating veterinary hospitals listed on the official recruitment page; screening through the study sites.

sites.hospital: Duma Animal Hospital (中和杜瑪動物醫院)
National Chung Hsing University Veterinary Teaching Hospital
Bubble Animal Hospital (泡泡動物醫院)
Jimmy Harry Animal Hospital (吉米哈利動物醫院)

upsert.notes: Official sponsor recruitment notice dated 2025-10-26 remains publicly listed; sponsor subsequently announced regulatory approval to conduct the Taiwan field trial on 2025-11-03 and continues to describe PT001 as an active oncology development program in 2026. Multicenter randomized open-label two-arm field trial of PT001, a PD-L1 and CTLA-4 recombinant-protein therapeutic vaccine, for confirmed stage II-III canine oral malignant melanoma. Age >=1 year. Owners must agree to suspend other cancer treatment. Excludes severe liver/kidney disease, autoimmune disease, bone-marrow disease or other high-risk systemic disease, dogs requiring steroids/immunosuppressants, and prior radiation. Tumor must be recordable/measurable. Trial contains a control arm. Final screening by study site is required.
